bibl.title: Rimskoe krepostnoe zodčestvo v Egipte. Roman Military Architecture in Egypt.
bibl.seg: Dmitry Karelin, Rimskoe krepostnoe zodčestvo v Egipte. Roman Military Architecture in Egypt.
Voprosy istorii fortifikacii. Questions of the History of Fortifications [Moscow] 2 (2011) pp. 4-26, 16 figg.
bibl.note: The paper presents the main results of the author's dissertation thesis. It is devoted to the architectural analysis of Roman fortresses in Egypt and their typology (mainly based on late Roman archaeological material).
